input: n is an integer in [1,1000000000]. lamps and queries contain in-bounds [row,column] integer pairs; duplicate lamps denote one active lamp, and repeated queries are allowed. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt; separately declared probabilities are finite primitive Number.
return: Fresh binary integer array reporting illumination immediately before each query turns off lamps in its surrounding 3 by 3 neighborhood. A lamp illuminates its full row, column and both diagonals.
mutation_aliasing: Input lamps/queries and their rows remain unchanged. Simulated lamp state, four count maps and output are private; the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Coordinate differences/sums and neighboring coordinates have magnitude at most 2000000000. Counts never exceed the number L of unique lamps, and never go negative because removal requires active membership. Tuple/string coordinate keys are injective. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Expected O(L_input + Q + 1) time and O(L + Q + 1) auxiliary/output space under bounded-key map/set assumptions. Each query checks at most nine coordinates, and each unique lamp is added/removed at most once. Zero-count map entries are deleted. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.

helpers.name: changeCount
helpers.contract: Adjusts a private nonnegative occupancy count, deleting the key when it becomes zero. Callers remove only active lamps, so decrements cannot create negative counts.
helpers.cost: Expected O(1) time per bounded-key map update, counted for all four indexes on each add/remove. The complete definition is 187 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.
